shortDescription: Continue one project across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini without re-explaining everything.
description: MaglaSync Free helps ordinary AI users continue the same project across ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. It keeps a compact local project state — goals, key decisions, constraints, results, blockers and next steps — and lets the user review the handoff before placing it into a fresh chat. No MaglaSync account, AI API key, cloud backend or analytics is required.
